Verses.1: At early dawn on the first day of the week, the women came to the tomb. They brought with them the spices they had prepared.
Verses.2: They found the stone had been rolled away from the tomb.
Verses.3: When they entered, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.
Verses.4: They were there, perplexed about this. Then suddenly, two men stood near them. It looked like they were clothed in lightning itself.
Verses.5: Terrified, the women bowed down with their faces to the ground. The men said to them, "Why do you look for the living among the dead?
Verses.6: He is not here. He has risen! Remember how He spoke to you while He was still with you in Galilee.
Verses.7: He said, 'the Son of Man must be handed over to sinners, be crucified, and on the third day rise from the dead.'"
Verses.25: He said to them, "You foolish men and how slow of heart you are believe all that the prophets have spoken!
Verses.26: Was it not necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and then enter into His glory?"
Verses.27: Then, beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, He explained to them the things written about Himself across the scriptures.
Verses.28: As they approached the village they were going to, He appeared to be going farther.
Verses.29: But they strongly urged him, saying, "Stay with us. It is nearly evening and the day is almost over." So He went in to stay with them.
Verses.30: When He had reclined at the table with them, He took the bread and blessed it. He broke it and began giving it to them.
Verses.31: Then their eyes were opened, and they recognized Him, but He vanished before them.
Verses.32: They asked each other, "Were not our hearts burning within us as He spoke to us on the road? While He was explaining the Scriptures to us?"
Verses.33: They got up and immediately returned to Jerusalem. There they found the eleven (disciples), and those with them gathered together.
Verses.34: They told them, "The Lord has risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!"
Verses.35: They began to recount what happened on the road and how He was recognized by them the moment he broke the bread.
Verses.36: While they were still sharing these things, Jesus Himself stood among them and said to them, "Peace be with you."
Verses.37: They were startled and frightened, thinking that they were seeing a spirit.
Verses.38: But He said to them, "Why are you frightened, and why do doubts arise in your hearts?
Verses.39: See My hands and My feet. I am Myself. Touch Me and see, because a spirit does not have flesh and bones, as you see that I have."
Verses.40: When He had said this, He showed them His hands and feet.
Verses.41: While, in their joy and amazement, they still did not believe it. He said tot hem, "Have you anything here to eat?"
Verses.42: They gave Him a piece of broiled fish,
Verses.43: which He took it and ate in their presence.
Verses.44: Then He said to them, "This is what I told you while I was still with you. That all the things that are written about Me in the Law of Moses and the Prophets and the Psalms must be fulfilled."
Verses.45: He then opened their minds so they could understand the Scriptures.
Verses.46: He told them, "So it is written, that the Christ would suffer and rise from the dead on the third day.
Verses.47: And repentance for forgiveness of sins would then be proclaimed in His name to all nations, beginning from Jerusalem.
Verses.48: You are witness to these things.
Verses.49: And behold, I am sending to you what My Father promised, but you are to stay in the city until you have been clothed with power from on high."
Verses.50: When Jesus had led them out as far as Bethany, He lifted up his hands and blessed them.
Verses.51: And while He was blessing them, He left them and was carried up into heaven.
Verses.52: Then they worshiped Him. After, they returned to Jerusalem with great joy.
Verses.53: They were continually in the temple blessing God.
